name: Tameeni Insurance
note: Wholly owned by Rasan Information Technology Company, a Saudi-listed fintech (Rasan IPO prospectus, May 2024; rasan.co IPO page calls Tameeni a flagship subsidiary). The prospectus named Rasan's direct 5%+ shareholders and stated there were no indirect owners of 5% or more, but Impact46's two funds, which held 17.55% post-IPO, exited Rasan in an accelerated bookbuild announced 13 Mar 2025 (Argaam: https://www.argaam.com/en/article/articledetail/id/1797009), so how much of that stake was sold, and who Rasan's current 5%+ holders are, is not sourced. Proposed tier unrated until Rasan's current 5%+ holders are sourced. Al Riyadh announced Tameeni as a sponsor on 28 Aug 2025 (riyadhclub.sa).
